model_output.rationale: 835 shows all lines denied CO-16 with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider). The 837P lists billing and rendering providers but no referring/ordering provider loop. Medicare Part B therapy claims require an ordering provider. Coverage is active (271 EB*1). Fix: add the referring provider NPI and resubmit as a new original (Part B does not accept frequency 7).

root_cause.explanation: Claim billed without a referring/ordering provider. 835 MOA N286 confirms the defect; 837P has no referring provider loop. All lines denied CO-16 for this omission.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering physician's name and NPI (verify in PECOS) to the referring provider loop. Resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3 = 1, no REF*F8). Part B does not accept frequency 7.

evidence.fact: All 4 lines denied CO-16; claim-level MOA remark N286 (missing/invalid referring provider primary identifier)
No referring/ordering provider loop present — only billing (NPI 1110692305) and rendering (NPI 1992501921) providers listed
Coverage active (EB*1) effective 2024-01-01 for DOS 2026-08-06 — eligibility is not the issue
Claim accepted for adjudication (status A2/20) on 2026-08-26 — was processed, not front-end rejected

citations.rule: CO-16 + N286: fix ordering/referring NPI and resubmit. Medicare Part B FFS accepts only CLM05-3 = 1.
N286 = missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider primary identifier. Verify NPI in PECOS, resubmit.
CO on Medicare FFS (MB): never bill the patient. Provider-side data defect → correct_and_resubmit.
